name: Shift Schedule
description: Shift-based rotation scheduling — configure rotations with min/target/max staffing, generate periods, and assign providers and students on a month grid
features: Configure rotations (e.g. MICU APP 12-hour day/night, Hospitalist Nights with Admitter/Nocturnist lanes)
Generate schedule periods for a month per rotation
Month grid with fill-state coloring (understaffed, below target, at target, extra)
Manual assignment of providers, with optional student shifts that don't count toward staffing
Per-period staffing overrides and same-day double-booking warnings
